node.statement: Height collapse: for an exact signed idempotent P with 0 < delta(P) <= 1/4, nonempty visible set W(P), and hidden top vertex v (height H = dist_1(p_v, conv W) maximal among rows), the invisible mass sigma_v and the row negative mass nu_v satisfy H * (1 - sigma_v) <= nu_v * (2 + 4*delta).
